# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 55

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 055
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "hate" vs. "put me above"

**Verse:** vv.1-2
**EMET/LOGOS:** "hate"
**PNEUMA:** "put me above"
**Issue:** Moste = hate. PNEUMA softens the language for a modern audience. But Thomas, like Luke 14:26, uses the strong form. The difficulty of the saying is part of its content.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Hate" retained — the strong form preserved.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "bear his cross in my way" vs. "carry their cross the way I do"

**Verse:** v.2
**EMET/LOGOS:** "bear his cross in my way"
**PNEUMA:** "carry their cross the way I do"
**Issue:** "In my way" (Coptic n sa moi) = following my path/way. "The way I do" (PNEUMA) implies Jesus himself carries a cross. "In my way" is the more accurate directional sense.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Bear his cross in my way" retained.

---
